name: M. Guard 1
body:
A burly-looking troll in a surprisingly clean and well kept suit of studded leather armor. He’s bored with the humans around him and is awkwardly playing with a deck of cards with his huge claws.

Elite Troll
CR 6

XP 3,200
CE Large humanoid (giant)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+3 armor, +4 Dex, +7 natural, –1 size)
hp 75 (6d8+48); regeneration 5 (acid or fire)
Fort +13, Ref +6, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +11 (1d8+7), bite +10 (1d8+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d6+10)

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 19, Con 27, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +4; CMB +12; CMD 26
Feats Improved Natural Attack (claws), Iron Will, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Intimidate +3, Perception +6
Languages Common, Giant
Gear large studded leather
